checks.evidence: Normal New task action opens full page, no dialog
Required-description inline error and textarea focus
Cancel returns to original three-state populated board
Multiline create opens full Task detail, status To Do, no popup
Task success feedback clears after three seconds and URL marker is removed
Edit description is a prefilled content page, not a dialog
Cancel editing discards draft, preserves saved description
Ctrl+Enter saves changed description while identity/status remain unchanged
Back to tasks preserves board search and shows created/edited task card
Existing In Progress task opens as page; status stays read-only
Delete uses explicit inline confirmation, not a popup or immediate deletion
Cancelling deletion keeps the task and returns focus to Delete task
Confirmed removal returns to board; only selected mock task removed
Unknown/missing Task route has clear recovery, not a popup or blank page
Narrow create succeeded; fresh UI inspection confirms Task detail and expired notice after locator wait reported a deadline/no-match diagnostic
New Project with zero workspaces → full-page New Task → detail → board shows created task
New Project card reflects one open task after creation (visible no-workspaces label, corrected locator)
No browser console errors during the stable task-page validation

No agent execution, status tools, dependencies or results implemented
Narrow browser viewport, not a device/soft-keyboard test
One narrow-expiry locator wait returned a deadline/no-match; fresh DOM independently verified successful creation and notice absence
